Corrections

Broomfield View collects public information from official sources with software, and software sometimes gets something wrong — a time zone, a duplicate, a source that changed after we read it. This page is a public record of what's been corrected and when, not just a promise to do it.

Spotted a mistake? Let us know — a link to the page helps.
